newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters says even chance of deal with Nat/Lab.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters says even chance of deal with Nat/Lab.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters said on Tuesday the chances of him entering a coalition deal with either the conservative National Party or the Labour Party were about even.
Peters was asked at a news conference to comment on Prime Minister Jim Bolger's remark that the chances of National leading the next government were about even.
"I think if that's 50-50 Labour, 50-50 National, that's about even, yes, that's fair enough," Peters said.
Peters said coalition talks, in which his party holds the balance of power, could last until Christmas but this was not necessarily harmful.
"It's better to take time to get it right," he said.
He said he would be negotiating with National and Labour at roughly the same time in what he called a "dual negotiating process". He expected it to start next week.
"We are ready to go," Peters said.
